**Unlock the Arcane Cultist with the Masterius NPC**
*- AC is unlocked in W6, Zone 4 with Baby Trolls at Masterius NPC who gives you a quest.
- The quest is to "listen to your inner voice" and to kill 400 tremor wurm in 200 seconds*

## What is an Arcane Cultist?

**A**rcane **C**ultist (AC) is the Master class of Bubonic Conjurer (Bubo)
Beginner -> Mage -> Shaman -> Bubonic Conjurer  -> Arcane Cultist

Arcane Cultist gameplay focuses on entering an "Arcanist form" through a toggle-able talent similar to Wraith or Tempest of previous master classes and rebuilding your combat stats in this new mode.
- The AC class has access to wands and rings from drops similar a WW but you are limited to 100 of each per daily reset and they do not require upgrade stones
- **IMPORTANT!**
Your Tenteyecle talent will be disabled in Arcanist form to begin and is enabled again via an upgrade in the tesseract

To progress your AC through maps you will need to defeat a certain number of arcane mobs in a set time with the to clear the arcane barrier **YOU MUST PLACE THE CRYSTAL FOR ARCANE MOBS TO SPAWN!**
- The base amount of regular kills required to spawn an arcane mob wave is 200, this can be reduced with an upgrade in the tesseract.
- Arcane mobs are immune to any damage that is not treated as arcane. The only current arcane attacks are  the "arcane skulls" talent and a tesseract upgrade to make basic attacks arcane

**The crystal you must have placed in either purple, yellow or blue on a map to progress**
https://imgur.com/7U7PVZP

## So why play an Arcane Cultist? Bonuses include:
Massive boosts to summoning stats, xp and essence generation through talents. Remember to re-do your summoning stones at these locations! (thank you <@257415519471271936> for the list)
- White: Bamboo spirits in W6
- Yellow: Royal Eggs in W6
- Green: Lantern Spirit in W6
- Blue: The Equinox in W3
- Purple: Gelatinous Cubes in W4
- Red: Crawlers in World 5
- Cyan: Samurai Guardians in W6

- 40% or more chance for statues and gold food to drop double quantity on all classes at all times, works both active & AFK!
- 1.5x or more permanent DR, AFK & XP gain on maps by clearing waves of arcane mobs on that map
- 3 new lab jewels to increase each of the master class resources (bones, dust & tachyons)
- Increased strength to all star signs (late game)
- Access to "prisma bubbles" that double the effect of any passive alchemy bubble (the small ones)

## How to get talent points for your Arcane Cultist

**IMPORTANT! Alchemy does NOT give Talent points to Tab 5!**

**Talents Points: **
- 3 Talent Points every Class level above 250 (including 250)
- 50 Flurbos from Dungeon
- 100 W6 Merit Shop (+5 per level)
- Far into the Death Bringer grimoire has 50-100 reasonably obtainable points
- Far into the Wind Walker nomadic compass path has 50-100 reasonably obtainable points
- 1 Talent point per every 5th Level per individual skill from W1-W3 skills
```(level - 249) * 3 + flurbo + 5 * merit + Sum(floor(skillLevel / 5), for each w1-w3 skill)```
credit to <@146038451790282753> for the formula I believe! ❤️ 
For the Skill levels, this means if woodcutting is level 9, you get 1 point (because level 5) If you have woodcutting and mining level 9 each thats only 2 points, you do NOT add the skills up together, its per individual skill.

Thank you <@1127838186090012682> for the infographic below!

**How to get Level 400+ Talents**

## Levelling up your Arcane Cultist

The Arcane Cultist class relies a lot more on max talent level (**sometimes requiring 350 or potentially even 400 max talent level to progress**) and total talent points than previous master classes, if you're in need of more talent points some of the best sources of class XP are:
- Justice Monument in cavern 10
- Grind Time bubble in yellow alchemy cauldron
- Abomination kills in Wind Walker class through Slayer Abominator talent
- Medallions obtained on Wind Walker through Shiny Medallions Talent
- Golden Nigri from world 6 crystal candlelights
- Adding golden nigri to the beanstalk in W6
- Some high end or limited time gear such as emperor wings or 4th Anniversary name plate

Important for levelling your Arcane Cultist:
- Active xp is a lot higher than AFK gain
- Crystal spawns account for a lot of xp gain, so equip a choco chip and level/exalt your Crystallin Stamp for maximum gains

## Nuke Platforms

Various platforms on maps while clearing arcane barriers cause more skulls to be fired per cast than usual, this can make certain barriers much easier to pass and should be used wherever possible. 

These platforms are always on maps with and either on or directly above an interactable object (NPC, Skill node, summoning stone) often making them the highest platform on a map & will be shown where available in the map progression section.

https://imgur.com/ykfsN0C

## Checklist before you begin
- Remove any prayers that increase the health on monsters
- claim your books via the library for max talent levels
- Max the mana & alch boxes in the post office for Cooldowns & alchemy gains
- Use your new summoning skill talents to progress your summoning waves, this can provide talent levels via the equinox and many account wide boosts
- Maximise your sources of Tachyons from the list below and infographic provided:
Arcade bonus for up to 400% bonus with deer companion & super status (blue ball upgrade)
Arcanist crown from the limited shop for 25% extra tachyons
Arcane Cultist pack in the gem shop for 1.2x

## Arcanist talents explained
https://imgur.com/pCv1sMx

If a talent is referred to as "talent 1" or "talent 8" it is being counted left to right in each row starting from the top.

- Talent 4 "Arcane Crystals" spawns 3 arcane mobs at base & 1 extra per 50 levels in the talent (9 at 300, 10 at 350 and so on) so it is **important to only level this skill in multiples of 50!**
- Talent 5 "Overwhelming Energy" is not important for progressing in maps and should be mostly ignored until much later into your Arcane Cultist journey
- Talent 8 "Labotomizer" scales off of your AC's Laboratory level and as such is only as good as your level in the skill, if your lab level is low consider investing minimal points here to put them elsewhere
- Talent 4 "Arcane Crystals" **important to only level this skill in multiples of 50!**

**Arcane Cultist Talents written out:**
https://imgur.com/rGrWTbB

## Arcane Cultist talent point priority

**Note: Once you have unlocked rings/gotten enough accuracy change the priority order of 5 & 7**

while pushing AC, the bottlenecks vary between accuracy or damage depending on progression but in general you should max your talents in the following order:

- **Backup Energy **- As arcane barriers are our form of progression, lowering the kills required is a no brainer, and the tachyon bonus on top makes this talent head and shoulders above the rest

- **Arcane Crystals** - Remember, as this skill only improves every 50 levels, only take it to your highest multiple of 50 whether thats 300, 350 or 400

- **Tesseract** - unlocking new tesseract upgrades ASAP can be the difference between breaking a wall or being soft locked, this skill can be reset to 1 point while trying to surpass a particularly tricky map!

- **Arcane Skulls **- With auspicious aura being nerfed with this update sizzling skull has become our primary form of damage playing AC

- **Ghoulish Power** - While we don't need the defence, accuracy can be a big issue until late W3 after you unlock rings, at which point swap this for Ghastly Power (talent 6) instead

- **Labotomizer** - Remember - this skill is only as good as your AC's lab level. If you have a particularly low lab level and don't want to spend the time improving it before playing AC consider investing less points here and instead spending them in talent 6 & 7

- **Ghastly Power** - Attack speed is not the easiest to come by and this skill only gets better over time

- **Arcanist form** - Not mandatory by any means except the single point to enter arcanist mode but the damage is always nice to have

Any left over points can be spent in talent 10 Primo Prisma as it is the best remaining options, well done on having enough talent points to get this far!

## SUPER TALENTS

Once you unlock super talents in World 7 the priority for pushing arcanist mode is as follows:
- 1. Arcane Crystals
- 2. Backup Energy
- 3. Tenteyecle (if you can reach level 600)
- 4. Sizzling Skulls
- 5. Labotomizer 
- 6. Ghastly Power
- 7. Arcane Skulls
- 8. Arcanist form
- 9. Cranium cooking for general use or concoctions to help push World 6 maps

https://imgur.com/C7GNReI Thank you <@484506083600236584> for help with the image!

## Equipping your Arcane Cultist

Not many stats carry over when you begin playing in Arcanist mode. You can however make good use of respawn rate gear until your tenteyecle talent is back online & movement speed potions can be equipped to give a bonus.

Other than this your best option is to use drop rate and money % equipment along with crystal spawn chance (if making use of the Glitterbug & Tachion of the Titans prayers).

There is an upgrade later on to make use of focusing purely on as high a drop rate as you can manage, but this unlock is far into the tesseract.

## Arcanist Staffs & Cultist Rings

Arcanist Staffs & Cultist Rings can be obtained from any monster in the game once unlocked through their respective tesseract upgrade. Unlike drops on a Wind Walker, these items do not require upgrade stones and their stat's are not dependant on the world you farm for them in.

The bonuses on your weapon and ring drops are tied to the quality % you have them levelled to in the tesseract and are limited to 100 drops of each per daily reset (**this limit can be reset with the use of a golden stopwatch**)

## Arcanist Staff's
You will unlock the ability to obtain staffs while still in world 1. the base drop rate of a staff is 1/300, scaling up to 1/600 for your 100th staff of the day.

At base, a staff can roll between 15-35 weapon power, up to 60% arcanist damage, up to 31% extra tachyons and 3-7 speed. 
- The minimum & maximum tachyon bonus of a staff increases by 1 every 15% quality
- The minimum & maximum damage bonus of a staff increases by 1 every 20% quality
- The minimum & maximum weapon power of a staff increases by 1 every 25% quality
- The maximum speed of a staff increases by 1 every 300% quality

## Cultist Rings
Cultist rings are unlocked near the end of world 3 when you are able to clear the Detonated Ram barrier and kill Bloodbones. The base drop rate of a ring is 1/500, scaling up to 1/1000 for your 100th ring of the day.

At base, a cultist ring provides up to 45% arcanist accuracy and up to 31% extra tachyons.
- The minimum & maximum tachyon bonus of a ring increases by 1 every 10% quality
- The minimum & maximum accuracy bonus of a ring increases by 1 every 15% quality

## Pincer Plateau - The Pincermin Wall
The size and amount of platforms on this map can require some strategy to move through

- You should remove Cranium Cooking from your ability bar like with any tough map
- Having your auto attack on but manually clicking the Raise Dead talent can provide more consistent uses of that skill to spawn more mobs

- form a party with friends on the map to spawn extra mobs
- equipping the giant and glitterbug prayers with a choco chip can provide many more spawns
